children: India's central bank governor said on Friday the Reserve Bank will not rule out any instruments to manage liquidity and keep the overnight rate aligned with the repo rate.
"We have enough tools to manage liquidity, other than VRRR, such as open market operations or FX swaps," Reserve Bank of India Governor Sanjay Malhotra said in an interview with CNBC-TV18.
